name: Rindo
source:
A mother with her child on the express. During her lifetime, she seems to have been a woman who married into a noble and distinguished family. She holds her child with great care, like something greatly precious to her.
[Translated from [url=https://enoshima210.work/2024/11/30/karudea/]official website[/url]]
